title: A quasi-coherent module with no associated points is zero
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a quasi-coherent F on a locally Noetherian scheme X, F = 0 if and only if Ass(F) is empty (source lines 171-178). One direction is the definition; for the converse the proof applies the algebra statement that a module with no associated primes is zero and spells out the translation back to schemes by restricting to any affine open and using the identification of associated points with associated primes.
